rv.q: BrightSide Theatre has The Addams Family version in all its creepy and kooky glory.
BrightSide Theatre's delightful professional production is the audience and critically approved version of the show.
BrightSide Theatre's The Addams Family Musical is recommended, offering a spirited, nostalgic, and thoroughly enjoyable night out for audiences of all ages.
There are no bad seats in the theater at Meiley-Swallow Hall, and it's a good choice to kick off the spookiest month with this show.
